# Berjaya AI Labs
> Berjaya AI Labs Sdn. Bhd. builds AI solutions for enterprises that want to improve productivity, automate workflows, and scale knowledge across teams.

## Homepage
- [Berjaya AI Labs](https://berjayaailabs.my/): Berjaya AI Labs creates AI solutions for modern enterprises across conversational systems, knowledge intelligence, private AI, automation, and machine vision.

## About
- [Overview](https://berjayaailabs.my/#about): Berjaya AI Labs Sdn. Bhd. builds AI solutions that help enterprises work smarter, respond faster, and scale knowledge across teams.

## What We Do
- [Voice AI Agents](https://berjayaailabs.my/#services): Conversational voice systems for service workflows, frontline engagement, and always-on support.
- [WhatsApp AI Agents](https://berjayaailabs.my/#services): Customer-facing AI assistants on messaging channels for improved responsiveness and streamlined service.
- [Enterprise Knowledge Assistants](https://berjayaailabs.my/#services): Grounded assistants that help teams access internal knowledge quickly.
- [Private AI Solutions](https://berjayaailabs.my/#services): Privacy-sensitive AI deployments designed for enterprise control and governance.
- [Workflow Automation](https://berjayaailabs.my/#services): AI connected with business processes and system actions to reduce manual effort.
- [OCR and Intelligent Document Processing](https://berjayaailabs.my/#services): Forms, reports, and documents converted into structured, searchable, action-ready information.
- [Social Listening and Intent Detection](https://berjayaailabs.my/#services): Digital-conversation monitoring to identify intent and support better decisions.
- [AI Vision Analytics](https://berjayaailabs.my/#services): Computer vision for pattern detection, environment monitoring, and operational insight.

## Leadership
- [Director](https://berjayaailabs.my/#director): Ir. Ts. Dr. Tham Mau Luen, also written as Tham Mau Luen or Mau Luen Tham, is the Director of Berjaya AI Labs Sdn. Bhd. and leads the development of AI solutions that drive innovation and digital transformation.
